cards.text: Bread mold and honey, bound in linen the way grandmother taught. It was meant to draw the sickness out — nobody wrote down which direction was out. Press it to their wound and count backward from ten.

cards.name: Shallow Grave
cards.text: Buried in haste is remembered in full. What the ground barely holds, the hand barely needs to reach for — and the disturbed dead, being briefly awake, are briefly generous. And briefly angry.
